question: Which doctrines characterize the śāktas and the buddhists in this enumeration?
premises: The śāktas are devoted to the doctrine of nature.
The buddhists are proponents of the extreme doctrine of void.
inference: Śāktas are associated with nature-doctrine and buddhists with the doctrine of void.
plain_english: The śāktas are devoted to the doctrine of nature, and the buddhists are proponents of the extreme doctrine of void.
